title: Boolean scan update
statement: Define a map on a phase and a natural counter, with a Boolean input. In phase $n0$, input true increments the counter and leaves the phase at $n0$, while input false changes the phase to $sep$ and leaves the counter unchanged; in every other phase, the pair is unchanged for either Boolean input.
